newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Parliament to adjourn for Melbourne Cup.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Parliament to adjourn for Melbourne Cup.

text.p: The Australian government said on Monday that Parliament would adjourn for 30 minutes on Tuesday to allow parliamentarians to watch the nation's leading horse race, the Melbourne Cup.
Science Minister Peter McGauran said parliament would rise at 3.00 p.m. (0400 GMT) and would resume at 3.30 p.m. (0430 GMT).

"There is an event occurring at 3.20 p.m. tomorrow afternoon, namely the Melbourne Cup, for which the whole nation stops and it's only fitting therefore that the parliament joins in the celebration of that great event," McGauran told parliament.
He said the adjournment plan would require the co-operation and assistance of ministers and the opposition in keeping question time proceedings short.
